Applications must be submitted online on or before 20-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Gandhinagar to complete the application. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar (IIT Gandhinagar) for various positions. It is a prestigious government institution.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for which applications are invited is Project Scientist. This role offers an excellent opportunity for qualified individuals.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Project Scientist post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Scientist position in this recruitment drive. Interested candidates should apply promptly.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Gandhinagar Project Scientist Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting online applications for the Project Scientist post is 20-08-2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the IIT Gandhinagar Project Scientist Recruitment 2026 is Online. Candidates need to submit their applications through the official website.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for the Project Scientist post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Scientist post is 45 years. Age relaxation rules may apply as per government norms.

faq.question: Q7. What is the required qualification for the Project Scientist position?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a PhD in AIHC & Archaeology, Heritage and Museum Studies, or Material Science with archaeometallurgy specialisation to be eligible for the Project Scientist post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for the Project Scientist post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Project Scientist position ranges from Rs. 60,000 to Rs. 1,25,000 per month. This is a competitive salary package.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for the IIT Gandhinagar Project Scientist Recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment. Applicants can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of IIT Gandhinagar?
faq.answer: The official website for Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar is https://www.iitgn.ac.in. All official notifications and application links can be found there.
